description: Phase 3F. Exercises the closed-enum redistribution_policy honour at engine_redistribute_route. Day 1 the rig seeds three routes: `r-share-none` (policy=none, cap=0), `r-share-deln` (policy=delegated_n, cap=2), `r-share-trans` (policy=transitive, cap=0). Day 3 the rig invokes engine_redistribute_route on `r-share-none`; the envelope MUST be `{"error":"policy_refuses"}`; `last_delegate_share_outcome` MUST be `policy_refuses`. Day 5 the rig invokes against `r-share-deln`; envelope MUST be `ok`; counter MUST be 1. Day 7 the rig invokes against `r-share-trans`; envelope MUST be `ok`; transitive policy admits unconditionally at the sender side (depth is enforced receiver-side, exercised by delegate-share-chain-depth-5). Day 10 the rig invokes engine_redistribute_route on a non-existent route id `r-bogus`; envelope MUST be `{"error":"route_unknown"}`. Day 14 ledger MUST surface the four distinct closed-enum outcomes (`policy_refuses`, `ok`, `ok`, `route_unknown`) in the audit. The legacy subscription-url block layers so the distribution-failure invariants continue to assert.
